title: chapter_master_packet
description: The ONE canonical chapter planning artifact persisted at ChapterPacket.body (schema_version 1). Produced/normalized exclusively by dominion.workers.packet.master.to_master_packet — a tolerant reader that also accepts the legacy AuthorPacketInternal shape (no hard migration; existing JSONB rows normalize on read). The flat legacy fields (four roster arrays, chapter_job/one_sentence_spine/entry_state/exit_state/emotional_spine, the lock arrays, the open_questions string list) remain present as COMPAT MIRRORS regenerated from the structured sections on every normalize; they double as the human editing surface, so on disagreement the mirrors win and the structured sections are rebuilt (per-name cast extras preserved). scene_seeds is the canonical scenes[] array (established key name kept) and exists exactly once as authoritative RAW planning data; the drafter-safe projection lives ONLY under the derived _surface_contract key. The ChapterPacket.open_questions column is a derived sync of chapter_contract.open_questions.

book_id.description: Stamped by writers when known; identity of the owning book.

status.description: Lifecycle mirror of the ChapterPacket.status column (proposed|approved|blocked), stamped by the same writers; the column stays the operational gate.

source_inputs.description: What the packet was authored from (outline size, canon handles, prior exit state / omniscient summary presence). Audit-only.

claims.description: Provenance-carrying claims: {claim, source_strength, source_id, source_title_or_file, excerpt?, confidence}.

open_questions.description: IN-BODY source of truth for open questions. items = unresolved (each blocks approval until adjudicated); resolved = author rulings ({q, a}-shaped entries) that downstream QA must treat as settled fact.

cast.description: Structured roster replacing the four flat arrays (which remain as derived compat mirrors). One entry per authored roster entry; contradictory double-bucketing is preserved for validation to flag as a repair task.

minimum_visible_evidence.description: The least on-page evidence (dialogue/action/description/thought/named reference) that satisfies reader_must_notice.

notes.description: The full authored roster entry with annotations (e.g. 'Brent (404 guild member)'); mirrors regenerate from this when it still leads with the name.

scene_seeds.description: The canonical scenes[] array — authoritative RAW planning data (may contain hidden canonical truth; INTERNAL_PLANNING scope). Exists exactly once: the drafter-safe projection of these seeds lives only under _surface_contract.scene_seeds.

seed_id.description: Server-minted stable id — the sync key for scene-packet derivation.

visible_character_evidence.description: Per-scene evidence plan for present/reader_must_notice cast members; consumed by the draft-time PRESENT_CHARACTER_NOT_VISIBLE check.

qa.description: Latest QA outcome folded into the artifact. Issue lists use the machine-readable severity shape ({kind, field, detail, severity, blocks_drafting, blocks_human_review, blocks_final_export}). LLM QA is advisory: its issues are capped at repair severity and never gate drafting.

lineage.description: Where this body came from (packet_author propose, human edit, or normalization of a legacy AuthorPacketInternal row).

_surface_contract.description: DERIVED, never authoritative: the drafter-safe projection (surface_contract.build_surface_contract) rebuilt by writers on every propose/body edit. Scene-packet derivation and any drafter-facing consumer read this view (master.drafter_view), never the raw top-level seeds.

characters_present.description: DERIVED compat mirror of cast[presence=present]; also the Desk editing surface.

open_questions.description: DERIVED compat mirror of chapter_contract.open_questions.items (legacy author-shape list).

claims.description: Top-level claims list (same objects as chapter_contract.claims).
